# f5xc_healthcheck (Data Source)

Health check configuration for a given cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Healthcheck - Full

data "f5xc_healthcheck" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_healthcheck.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_healthcheck.example.namespace
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) annotations Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `health_check_choice` (Attributes) health_check Specifies whether to perform HTTP Health Check or TCP Health check (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check_choice))
- `healthy_threshold` (Number) healthy threshold Number of successful responses before declaring healthy. In other words, this is the number of healthy health checks required before a host is marked healthy. Note that during startup, only a single successful health check is required to mark a host healthy.
- `interval` (Number) interval Time interval in seconds between two healthcheck requests.
- `jitter_choice` (Attributes) jitter_choice Configure jitter as a percentage of the health check interval to add random variation between successive requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jitter_choice))
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `timeout` (Number) timeout Timeout in seconds to wait for successful response. In other words, it is the time to wait for a health check response. If the timeout is reached the health check attempt will be considered a failure.
- `uid` (String) uid uid is the unique in time and space value for this object. Object create will fail if provided by the client and the value exists in the system. Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.
- `unhealthy_threshold` (Number) unhealthy threshold Number of failed responses before declaring unhealthy. In other words, this is the number of unhealthy health checks required before a host is marked unhealthy. Note that for http health checking if a host responds with 503 this threshold is ignored and the host is considered unhealthy immediately.

<a id="nestedatt--health_check_choice--http_health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check_choice.http_health_check`

Read-Only:

- `expected_response` (String) Expected response Raw bytes expected in the response of http health check. Input is to be given in Hex encoded format. If left empty, then response body is not considered for evaluating health check status.
- `expected_status_codes` (List of String) Expected Status Codes Specifies a list of HTTP response status codes considered healthy. To treat default HTTP expected status code 200 as healthy, user has to configure it explicitly. This is a list of strings, each of which is single HTTP status code or a range with start and end values separated by '-'.
- `headers` (Map of String) Headers to add in health check request Specifies a list of HTTP headers that should be added to each request that is sent to the health checked cluster. This is a list of key-value pairs.
- `host_header_choice` (Attributes) host header choice Specify the value of host header in the HTTP health check request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check_choice--http_health_check--host_header_choice))
- `path` (String) path Specifies the HTTP path that will be requested during health checking.
- `request_headers_to_remove` (List of String) Headers to be removed from health check request Specifies a list of HTTP headers that should be removed from each request that is sent to the health checked cluster. This is a list of keys of headers.
- `use_http2` (Boolean) Use HTTP2 If set, health checks will be made using http/2.

<a id="nestedatt--health_check_choice--tcp_health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check_choice.tcp_health_check`

Read-Only:

- `expected_response` (String) expected response raw bytes expected in the request. Describes the encoding of the payload bytes in the payload. Hex encoded payload.
- `send_payload` (String) send payload raw bytes sent in the request. Empty payloads imply a connect-only health check. Describes the encoding of the payload bytes in the payload. Hex encoded payload.



<a id="nestedatt--jitter_choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jitter_choice`

Read-Only:

- `default_jitter` (Boolean) default_jitter Use the default jitter value of 30 percent of the health check interval.
- `jitter_percent` (Number) jitter_percent Specify a custom jitter value as a percentage of the health check interval. Valid values are 0 (to disable jitter) and 10 to 50.
